'''Kragil''' was a soldier from the [[Borderlands]] in [[Lan Mandragoran]]'s army.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Kragil}} 

== Activities ==
Kragil fights in the Borderlander army at [[Tarmon Gai'don]] in the [[Last Battle]]. He is killed fighting a [[Myrddraal]].

{{quote|Of course the craziest thing I've seen these last few days is what Kragil did when fighting that Fade. Did any of you see it...|[[Andere]], another soldier from the Borderlands{{ref/book|14|9}}}}

==Trivia==
*Kragil is named after Craig Foster, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
